entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor immediately. I'm not playing any games, I want my money back now. I've had a major emergency and this is the last thing I have time to deal with.
I'm very sorry to hear that, I hope everything is okay. I can definitely look into the return process for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?

The name is Sam Jones, order number is 772-B-451. And let me just be clear: I was in the hospital, okay? I had to have emergency surgery, and now I'm facing a sudden military deployment. I haven't even opened the box. If you give me any grief over some policy, I will be writing a review on every single website you can imagine. This needs to be simple.
Thank you for that information, Mr. Jones, and for your service. I'm pulling up your order now. One moment... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor on December 31st.
And? What's the problem? I just told you what happened. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
There's no problem at all, sir. I apologize if I wasn't clear. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within that window.
Wait... what? Ninety days? Are you sure?

Yes, absolutely. I can approve this return for you right now, no issue. I've just initiated it in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Just attach that to the box and drop it off at any post office.
Oh. Wow. Okay. That's... that's a lot easier than I expected. I was ready for a fight. Thank you, Alex. I really appreciate you making this simple, especially after everything with the hospital.

Of course, Mr. Jones. We're happy to help. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you again for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for you soon. Have a good day.
